text:
maria (eng-platform): Quick sync — we need dashboards + alerts for the new runtime metrics from the model-serving runtime. Metrics: `runtime_request_latency_ms{quantile=~\"p50|p95|p99\"}`, `kv_cache_hit_rate`, `effective_batch_size`, `model_variant_fallbacks_total`. Aim: have dashboards + alerts before the Dedicated rollout next week. @alex @jon can you take ownership of thresholds and oncall routing?

alex (eng-sre): Yep, I can take thresholds. Need a suggested SLO and burn rate strategy. Do we want separate pager severities for p95 vs p99?

maria (eng-platform): My thinking: p50/p95 go to Ops Slack (no pager) for visibility; p99 and sustained p95 regression should page. We want:
- Sev2 (pager) for sustained p99 > 2s for 5m OR error budget burn rate > 5x over 30m
- Sev3 (email/Slack only) for p95 spikes > 800ms for 10m

jon (eng-oncall): That matches our ops capacity. For pager routing: Sev2 -> primary oncall (infra rotation). If primary is on vacation, fall back to eng-runtime rotation. Sev3 -> no pager, post to #eng-platform-alerts.

leila (eng-runtime): Two notes: `model_variant_fallbacks_total` increments when we downgrade model tier, that should trigger a Sev3 initially and escalate if > 5 in 15m. Also `kv_cache_hit_rate` should be a warning if it drops below 80% — low cache will cause cost and latency.

alex (eng-sre): Proposed PromQL for p99 latency alert:```yaml
- alert: HighRuntimeP99Latency
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(runtime_request_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, zone)) > 2000
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "runtime p99 latency > 2s ({{ $labels.model }}/{{ $labels.zone }})"
```
This pages directly. For error budget burn rate:```yaml
- alert: SLOBurnRateHigh
  expr: increase(slo_error_budget_consumed_total[30m]) / 30 > 5
  for: 0m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Open question: where does `slo_error_budget_consumed_total` come from — platform or runtime?

maria (eng-platform): Runtime should emit `slo_error_budget_consumed_total{team=\"runtime\",service=\"inference\"}` so we can re-use the same SLO plumbing. eng-runtime to confirm counters and labels.

leila (eng-runtime): Will add the metric. We'll increment on: request failures, model fallback, and when latency > model-specific target. Labels: `model`, `region`, `variant`.

jon (eng-oncall): Pager rules: Alertmanager config needs routes: match severity: page -> send to PD team `infra_primary`; if `region=eu` and business critical customer tag present, override to `oncall_sre_eu`. Also add `silence` automation for scheduled maintenance windows.

alex (eng-sre): I'll draft Alertmanager route snippet:```yaml
route:
  group_by: ["alertname","model","region"]
  routes:
  - match:
      severity: "page"
    receiver: "pagerduty/infra_primary"
    continue: true
  - match_re:
      region: "eu|eu-west"
    receiver: "pagerduty/oncall_sre_eu"
```
Will open a PR and link it.

sre-bot: New alert policy created: `HighRuntimeP99Latency` — awaiting review. :robot_face:

maria (eng-platform): Great. Action items:
- alex: PR for Alertmanager + rules (thresholds above) — due EOD tomorrow
- leila: emit `slo_error_budget_consumed_total` and labels, and add `model_variant_fallbacks_total` as described — due EOD tomorrow
- jon: confirm PD escalation mapping and test pageflow — schedule a short drill after PR merge

jon (eng-oncall): I'll add a test run and post results in this thread.

alex (eng-sre): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/alerting/pulls/482 — contains rule + route draft. Please review. :eyes:

leila (eng-runtime): Pushed metric changes to staging. `kv_cache_hit_rate` exported as a gauge, `slo_error_budget_consumed_total` as counter with labels.

maria (eng-platform): Thanks. Once PR is green, we should create a dashboard tab in Console: runtime -> latency & cache -> per-model and region filters. Also add a playbook link in alert annotations with runbook steps (check cache, rollback recent model rollout, scale up pool).

alex (eng-sre): Will add runbook link in annotations. Example annotation: `runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/high_p99`

jon (eng-oncall): Test drill scheduled Thu 09:30 PST. I'll rotate in test responder.

maria (eng-platform): :+1: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Dashboard layout mock in #eng-platform-design.

alex (eng-sre): One more: recommend adding a short windowed burn-rate metric for auto-escalation: `increase(slo_error_budget_consumed_total[5m]) / 5 > 10` to catch flash regressions — page if true. Thoughts?

leila (eng-runtime): Fine by me — helps catch bad regressions quickly. Make it a separate alert with `for: 0m` and higher noise tolerance config.

maria (eng-platform): Agreed. Keep the big burners as page and the medium ones as Slack-only.

sre-bot: Alert `SLOBurnRateHigh` is firing in staging (model:base, region:us-west).

jon (eng-oncall): Received page during test drill — routing worked to infra_primary. Logged outcome in incident ticket #INC-2026.

maria (eng-platform): Perfect. Closing the coordination loop here. If anything blocks, comment on the PR or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
